description: This file defines the InlineAdapter class, which is a RecyclerView adapter for displaying a list of Tasks in an Android application. It manages the creation and binding of task view holders, highlights the current task, and displays associated activities with clickable components.

classes.name: InlineAdapter
classes.description: A RecyclerView adapter that displays a list of Task objects, highlighting the current task and visualizing associated activities with clickable options.

classes.name: InlineAdapter.TaskViewHolder
classes.description: Defines how each task's view is managed within the RecyclerView, including setting task data, inflating activity views, and handling click events to show detail dialogs.

methods.name: InlineAdapter
methods.description: Constructor initializing the adapter with a list of tasks and the activity context; determines current task index.

methods.name: indexOfRunningTask
methods.description: Finds the index of the task that is currently running based on the activity's task ID.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Inflates the layout for individual task items and creates a new TaskViewHolder.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds task data to the view holder; highlights the current task.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the number of tasks in the list.

methods.name: setTask
methods.description: Prepares the view with task information, highlights the active activity, and sets up click listeners for activities.

methods.name: showDialogWithFlags
methods.description: Displays a dialog showing intent flags associated with the activity component.
